description:
Use this when the user wants tournaments or leagues to play in, near a location or by name. Not for court availability (search_courts), open play (search_open_play) or coaching (search_lessons).
Read-only: it searches CourtsApp's catalog of events and cannot register anyone. Each event has a registration url on the organizer's site: share it exactly as returned and let the user sign up there. Never say anyone is registered.
Location is optional (city+state, zip, or lat+lng; a state alone lists that state's events). With a city or zip it returns events within 150 miles, soonest first, each with distanceMiles; if none are that close it says so and returns the 2 nearest, which are not near, so never call them nearby. Without a location it returns the soonest events anywhere. Use q or name for an event name (e.g. "Moneyball"), type to limit to tournaments or leagues, and from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) for dates; it starts from today by default. maxResults is 1-10 (default 6).
Returns tournaments, each with name, eventType, venueName, city, state, startDate and endDate (calendar days), registrationCloseDate, closingSoon (registration closes within 5 days), priceMinCents and priceMaxCents with currency (cents; 0 means free), url, and distanceMiles; plus total and hint.

from.description: Optional first day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD: events still on or after it are returned. Defaults to today.

location.description: Where to look (150-mile radius). City+state or zip are preferred; a state alone lists that state's events with no distances. Use lat+lng only if the user provided real coordinates. Never use 0,0 or guess coordinates. Optional: leave it out to search everywhere.

maxResults.description: Number of events to return (1-10, default 6).

q.description: Optional event name or venue to look for, e.g. "Moneyball".

sport.description: Optional sport to find events for. Pass it whenever the user names one. Case-insensitive. Common aliases accepted (e.g. "pickle ball" → pickleball).

to.description: Optional last day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD: events starting on or before it are returned. Omit for no end date.

type.description: Optional: only tournaments, or only leagues. Leave it out for both.

name: search_tournaments
title: Find Tournaments
